task.instruction: Create a Word document and write a Japan itinerary for me.

subtasks.goal: A new blank Word document is open containing a written Japan itinerary (a title and a day-by-day plan, for example 7 days covering Tokyo, Hakone, Kyoto, Nara and Osaka with morning, afternoon and evening activities, food suggestions and travel tips) typed into it.

values.name: day1
values.text: Day 1 - Tokyo: Arrive at Narita or Haneda, check in, then explore Shinjuku. Evening: Omoide Yokocho for yakitori and the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building free observation deck.

values.name: day2
values.text: Day 2 - Tokyo: Morning at Meiji Shrine and Harajuku, lunch in Shibuya and Shibuya Crossing, afternoon at Asakusa and Senso-ji, evening at Tokyo Skytree or Akihabara.

values.name: day3
values.text: Day 3 - Hakone and Mt. Fuji area: Take the Romancecar from Shinjuku, ride the Hakone Loop (ropeway, Lake Ashi cruise), enjoy an onsen and a traditional ryokan dinner.

values.name: day4
values.text: Day 4 - Kyoto: Take the Shinkansen from Odawara to Kyoto. Afternoon at Fushimi Inari Shrine, evening stroll through Gion and dinner in Pontocho.

values.name: day5
values.text: Day 5 - Kyoto: Early visit to Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and Tenryu-ji, then Kinkaku-ji and Ryoan-ji, afternoon at Kiyomizu-dera and Higashiyama, evening at Nishiki Market.

values.name: day6
values.text: Day 6 - Nara and Osaka: Day trip to Nara for Todai-ji and the deer in Nara Park, then to Osaka. Evening: Dotonbori for takoyaki and okonomiyaki.

values.name: day7
values.text: Day 7 - Osaka and departure: Visit Osaka Castle in the morning, shop at Shinsaibashi, then head to Kansai International Airport for the flight home.

values.name: tips
values.text: Tips: Get an IC card (Suica or ICOCA), consider a data eSIM, carry some cash, book popular restaurants and ryokan in advance, and travel light as luggage space on trains is limited.
